Author: Anjani Kumar Mishra
Bench: Anjani Kumar Mishra
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:146101
Court No. - 43
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 42399 of 2022
Applicant :- Sakib

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashok Kumar Singh Bais
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Ch. Dil Nisar,Rohit Kumar Pandey Hon'ble Anjani Kumar Mishra,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA for the State.

This is second bail application filed on behalf of the applicant in Case Crime No. 185 of 2021, under Sections 498-A, 323, 504, 506, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Mahila Thana,
District- Saharanpur.
Counsel for the first informant has filed a counter affidavit in Court today.
The same is taken on record.
Counsel for the applicant does not propose to file any rejoinder affidavit in response to the counter affidavit filed by the counsel for the first informant.

Sakib vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9490317/
1

The contention of the counsel for the applicant is that he is brother-in-law (Devar) of the first informant and on account of a matrimonial dispute, the entire family has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The allegation in the impugned FIR is of rape.
The incident is said to have taken place on 28.12.2021 and on the same day, the informant was medically examined.
At that stage, the allegations were only of Mar-peet.
But, three days later, the FIR has been lodged alleging rape.
Not only is the allegation afterthought, even the medical report in this regard is of a date almost three months after the alleged incident.
In view of aforesaid submissions, the prayer for bail has been made.
The contention of counsel for the first informant is that the First Information Report has been lodged on 31.12.2021.
The matter was immediately, thereafter, referred to Mediation and file has been received back on 29.03.2022.
As such, the delay in the medical examination was on account of non-availability of the record.

The contention of learned AGA for the State is that informant has supported the prosecution case as set out in the First Information Report, in her statements under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. and,
therefore, the bail application is liable to be rejected.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and without commenting on its merits
, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.

Let the applicant Sakib involved in Case Crime No. 185 of 2021, under Sections 498-A, 323, 504,
506, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Mahila Thana, District- Saharanpur, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions;
1. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence or threaten the witnesses.
2. During trial, he shall not indulge in any criminal activities.
In breach of any condition enumerated above, Trial Court shall be at liberty to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law.
Order Date :- 21.7.2023 Aditya Tripathi  Sakib vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9490317/
